title: 📢 ANNOUNCEMENT | NO FACE-TO-FACE CLASSES
message:
Due to the inclement weather, there will be no face-to-face classes today, Wednesday, July 29, 2026. Classes will shift to asynchronous learning. Subject teachers will provide learning activities through the respective class group chats.

Students are reminded to accomplish the assigned tasks within the given schedule. Please stay safe indoors and continue to monitor your class group chats for updates. 🙏

Stay safe, Batang Holy! 💙💛
